# Alifia Hamzah — Detailed Profile & Portfolio Context

## Professional Summary
Alifia Hamzah (commonly referred to as Hamzah) is a Senior Product & Mobile App Designer with over 4 years of experience building and scaling data-driven enterprise platforms and top-tier mobile applications (iOS & Android) using a story-data design methodology. His work spans complex back-office SaaS systems and high-impact consumer and enterprise mobile applications across fintech, energy utilities, logistics, and retail.

Hamzah bridges rigorous user research, native operating system guidelines (Apple HIG & Google Material Design 3), and engineering constraints to craft high-conversion, highly accessible digital products.

## Core Expertise & Mobile Competency (5/5 Rating)
- **Mobile Application Design (iOS & Android)**: End-to-end UX/UI design compliant with Apple Human Interface Guidelines (HIG) and Google Material Design 3 (Material You). Deep expertise in mobile navigation patterns (bottom sheets, gestures, tab architecture), micro-interactions, haptics, responsive touch targets, and offline-first state handling.
- **Fintech & Banking Mobile UX**: Architecting secure, frictionless financial journeys for digital banks (e.g. Bank Raya), including KYC onboarding, biometric authentication, QRIS payments, micro-lending funnels, and real-time transaction tracking.
- **Enterprise & Utility Mobile UX**: Designing mission-critical mobile tools for field technicians, enterprise customers, and logistics operators (e.g. PGN Mobile, Proovia).
- **Cross-Platform Mobile Design Systems**: Standardizing mobile token architectures (colors, spacing, typography, component states) in Figma and maintaining parity with native Swift/Kotlin and React Native/Flutter codebases.
- **Story-Data Design Methodology**: Integrating qualitative user stories with dense quantitative metrics to make high-volume enterprise and consumer mobile applications actionable and intuitive.

## Production Mobile Applications

### 1. Bank Raya Mobile App (Fintech / Digital Banking)
- **Client / Product**: Bank Raya Indonesia (PT Bank Raya Indonesia Tbk — digital bank subsidiary of BRI)
- **Role**: Mobile App Product / UI/UX Designer
- **Platforms**: iOS & Android
- **Scope & Impact**:
  - Redesigned core consumer banking touchpoints: account dashboard, biometric login, transfer funnels, and micro-loan application flows.
  - Simplified multi-step regulatory and KYC verification into a progressive, transparent mobile onboarding flow, substantially lowering signup abandonment.
  - Formulated clear visual hierarchy for transaction histories, budget management, and contextual notifications adhering to strict banking security and accessibility standards.

### 2. PGN Mobile App (Energy & Utilities)
- **Client / Product**: PT Perusahaan Gas Negara (PGN / Pertamina Gas Negara)
- **Role**: Mobile UI/UX Designer
- **Platforms**: iOS & Android
- **Scope & Impact**:
  - Designed the official mobile application serving residential and commercial natural gas customers across Indonesia.
  - Streamlined monthly gas meter recording, smart telemetry reporting, billing histories, and multi-channel payment gateway integrations.
  - Designed emergency reporting and customer service assistance flows with clear status feedback and offline-first data caching for areas with unstable network connectivity.

### 3. Proovia Mobile App (Smart Logistics & Fleet Telemetry)
- **Company / Product**: PT Neuronworks Indonesia (Proovia)
- **Role**: Mobile UI/UX Designer & Design System Lead
- **Platforms**: iOS & Android
- **Scope & Impact**:
  - Standardized the complete Proovia UI/UX Design System for mobile and web, establishing cohesive component libraries and interaction guidelines.
  - Designed driver dispatch workflows, real-time GPS fleet tracking, delivery confirmation signatures, and daily route optimization interfaces.
  - Validated with field drivers and logistics managers, eliminating operational bottlenecks and ensuring effortless one-hand usability while on the move.

### 4. Alfagift Mobile Live Track & Chat (Omnichannel Retail)
- **URL**: https://hamzah.design/work/5x-retention-with-live-track-and-chat-in-alfagift-mobile-apps
- **Role**: Product Designer
- **Platforms**: iOS & Android
- **Impact**: 5x increase in customer retention through real-time order tracking and interactive in-app customer service chat.
